## Rule

A two-color rectangle and one `8` marker are present. Extend the rectangle side
facing the marker until the marker's row or column becomes the new rectangle
edge. Preserve the original perimeter color on the new perimeter, preserve/fill
the original interior color inside that perimeter, keep background inside the
active input grid, and keep padding outside the active grid all-zero.

## Algorithm sketch

```python
nonbg = input colors 1..9
y0, y1 = min/max row containing nonbg  # includes the 8 marker
x0, x1 = min/max col containing nonbg
outer = rectangle color with the larger count  # border
inner = the other positive rectangle color
active = cells inside the original input HxW

for each cell in 13x13:
    if not active:
        label = 10  # sentinel, emits no output channel
    elif not (y0 <= r <= y1 and x0 <= c <= x1):
        label = 0
    elif r in {y0, y1} or c in {x0, x1}:
        label = outer
    else:
        label = inner
output = Equal(label, channel_ids_0_to_9), padded to 30x30
```

## Cost analysis

LIVE 30342 is dominated by 13x13 ten-channel planes: F32/F16 input crop, three
F16 one-hot contribution planes, and a F16 one-hot output-active plane.

v3 avoids materialized input crops by using free-input Einsum marginals for
row/column/color statistics. It constructs one 13x13 F16 label plane and only
one BOOL one-hot tail before BOOL Pad to graph output. Measured
`score_network_v2`: `(macs=0, memory=4746, params=99)`, cost `4845`.

v8 removes the label plane entirely. It computes row/column active, interval,
and edge factors, color-role selectors, then emits the full 10x30x30 graph output
as the final free F16 `Einsum` logits. The row/column active factors use raw
combo-profile margins; color-positive is a F32-to-BOOL cast and inner color is
`color_positive XOR outer_bool`. Measured `score_network_v2` on the staged copy:
`(macs=0, memory=1646, params=89)`, cost `1735`.

## Floor proof (session 2026-06-12, worker-281)

**v8 at 1735 (memory=1646, params=89) is the floor for this algorithm design.**

Every byte of the 1646B memory is load-bearing:

| Component | Size | Why irreducible |
|---|---:|---|
| row_combo, col_combo [1,30] F32 | 240B | Einsum over F32 input; narrowing input to F16 costs more than it saves |
| row/col fg detection BOOL×2 + UINT8×2 | 120B | ArgMax rejects BOOL (verified 2026-06-09); UINT8 is minimum integer for ArgMax |
| active_row_h, active_col_h [1,30] F16 | 120B | Needed as row_feat[0]/col_feat[0] for bg-mode active detection |
| y0,y1,x0,x1 [1] INT64 | 32B | ArgMax always outputs INT64; no output-dtype attribute |
| 12 interval BOOL [1,30] | 360B | 4 GreaterOrEqual/LessOrEqual + 4 Equal + 4 And/Or per axis; each comparison produces 30B BOOL |
| 4 F16 interval features [1,30] | 240B | Cast BOOL→F16 needed for F16-only Einsum; UINT8→F16 saves nothing |
| row_feat, col_feat [3,30] F16 | 360B | Concat needed to pack 3 row/col features for the mode-indexed Einsum |
| Color count pipeline | 44B | rect_color_counts [1,10] F32 + rect_count_max [1,1] |
| Color role BOOLs×3 + F16×2 + chan_feat | 130B | outer/inner selection; essential for mode-indexed chan_feat |

Params (89):
- `offs30` [1,30] INT64 = 30 (all 30 positions needed; dtype change saves 0 params)
- `coef` [3,3,3] F16 = 27 (3 modes × 3 row feats × 3 col feats; fully utilized)
- `combo_mask` [10] F32 = 10 (per-channel combo weights; bg=1 active, others=17 fg)
- `rect_color_mask` [1,10] F32 = 10 (per-channel rect count; ch0 and ch8 excluded)
- `bg_vec` [1,10] F16 = 10 (background channel selector for chan_feat Concat)
- `fg_thresh` [1] F32 = 1 (Greater threshold; cannot be derived from other scalars cheaply)
- `batch_one_h` [1] F16 = 1 (free Einsum batch factor; removal needs 18000B Unsqueeze intermediate)

Attempted nibbles (all ruled out 2026-06-12):
- **Cast(F32→UINT8) direct ArgMax**: ORT uses modular (not saturating) cast, breaking fg/bg distinction even with combo_mask=[1,255,...].
- **Cast(BOOL→F16) for ArgMax**: produces F16 [1,30]=60B per axis vs UINT8 [1,30]=30B. Worse.
- **Remove batch_one_h**: would require Unsqueeze after Einsum, creating 18000B intermediate.
- **INT32 offs30**: element count unchanged (30), no params savings; intermediates unaffected.
- **Row/col feat without Concat**: any split of [3,30] into 3 separate [1,30] tensors forces materialized partial products (18000B each).
- **Derive fg_thresh from combo_mask**: arithmetic for 17-1=16 costs more ops than the 1-param scalar.
- **Merge rect_color_mask with combo_mask**: differ at ch8 (marker excluded from rect counts but included in fg detection).

## Reviewer verdict (2026-06-12, reviewer-281, DROP confirmed)

Independent 4-angle attack, all exhausted. Floor=1735 confirmed:
- **A (12 interval BOOL)**: nodes 12-23 in v8: r_ge_y0, r_le_y1, row_in_bool, r_eq_y0, r_eq_y1, row_edge_bool × 2 axes = 12 × [1,30] BOOL = 360B. No ONNX "between" op; no collapse path.
- **B (feat Concat)**: [3,30] F16 Concat (180B per axis) is optimal. Split → 3 separate Einsums → partial products [10,30,30] F16 = 18000B each. Net increase by tens of kB.
- **C (output tail)**: free-Einsum directly to [1,10,30,30] F16 output (not counted) is uniquely optimal. Any label-map intermediate ≥ 900B UINT8 before Equal-expansion. v3 costs 4845.
- **D (params)**: param→compute always adds more memory than params saved. offs30 (30 INT64) via Range saves 26 params but adds ~480B memory → net +454. bg_vec OneHot: net +13. No folding profitable.

## Cross-formulation wall-proof (2026-06-21, worker W14) — 1735 is a FAMILY-INDEPENDENT floor

Re-measured live baseline FIRST: v8 `score_v2` = (macs=0, memory=1646, params=89)
= **1735**; `profile_real_cost --arcgen 266` = static 1735 / profile 1735 (graph
is fully static, no dynamic-shape fiction); visible 266/266 PASS; byte-equal-full
200266/200266 vs LIVE (prior gate record). No lower staged home candidate exists
(v8 was moved to `staged_submits/_incorporated_archive_20260620_152315/`; v3=4845,
v10 probe=1855 are both higher). Strict-below bar = 1735.

**Why 1735 holds across ALL output families, not just the Einsum logits.**

The whole charged memory (1646B) feeds a single FREE final node
`Einsum('mc,mfg,fr,gs,b->bcrs')` → `[1,10,30,30]` F16 output (18000B, uncounted,
#67/#78). The trilinear `coef[m,f,g]` (3 modes × 3 row-feats × 3 col-feats)
performs the inclusion-exclusion that defines perimeter vs interior:
`outer = row_in·col_edge + row_edge·col_in − row_edge·col_edge`,
`inner = row_in·col_in − (the edge terms)`. This REQUIRES `in_span` and `on_edge`
as **independent rank-1 row/col factors that multiply pairwise**. That product
structure is exactly what keeps the output free with zero 2D plane.

Pricing each alternative final-output family against v8's 1646B charged memory:

| Route (output family) | Min charged memory | Verdict vs 1735 |
|---|---:|---|
| 1. Label-canvas + Equal-tail | ≥900B canvas + same 600B bbox/interval derivation + Equal-expand | LOSS (v3 analog = 4845) |
| 2. Broadcast-mask `Where` output | 2× `[1,30,30]` BOOL masks = 1800B just for perimeter/interior | LOSS |
| 3. Code-select (pack in/edge into U8 `[1,30]`) | packing destroys the trilinear product → forces Gather/Equal → 2D plane → collapses into route 1 | LOSS |
| 4. U8 MaxPool span membership (#105) | +60B/axis over v8 (Unsqueeze/2×MaxPool/Min/Squeeze U8) | measured 1855 = LOSS |
| 5. v8 free-output separable Einsum (current) | 1646B | **= 1735 FLOOR** |

**Per-axis interval irreducibility (the charged tensor that resists):** locating a
2-boundary span (y0,y1) needs ≥2 comparisons + ≥1 combine, and the (in_span,
on_edge) decomposition each needs ≥1 BOOL `[1,30]` (30B) + a Cast→F16 `[1,30]`
(60B) to feed the F16 Einsum — there is no ONNX "between" op and no op that
yields edge-from-in without re-deriving shifted bounds (same cost). The **12
interval BOOL `[1,30]` = 360B** (6/axis) plus the **4 F16 interval features = 240B**
are the resisting charge; no formulation eliminates them without materializing a
≥900B 2D plane elsewhere. **1735 is a cross-formulation floor. DROP confirmed.**

## Trilu/code-select floor confirm (2026-06-23, worker-13)

Re-measured run-local team-best first:
`staged_submits/_incorporated_archive_20260620_152315/task281_direct_einsum_colorxor_cost1735/task281.onnx`
has SHA256 `606300aa18919e5b036d4a6931e6ff609f991f0233e2c207cce3e7f9da3fdb1d`,
`score_v2=(macs=0, memory=1646, params=89)`, cost 1735, and
`profile_real_cost --arcgen 262` reports static=1735/profile=1735 over 266 real
inputs. Full gates re-run this session: visible 266/266, truth 200000/200000,
AB-vs-LIVE 200266/200266 byte-equal. Strict-below bar remains 1735.

**#150 Trilu span generator loses.** Trilu's diagonal offset is a static
attribute, so a data-dependent span `(y0 <= r <= y1)` cannot be produced by a
single dynamic Trilu call. The usable route is a generated or stored triangular
`[30,30]` operand, then Gather/Slice at `y0/y1/x0/x1` to recover threshold
vectors. That operand is charged either as a 900-element initializer or as a
900B BOOL intermediate (1800B if F16), before the four `[1,30]` F16 factors still
needed by the final F16 Einsum. #150 can reuse one triangle for both directions
by subscript swap, but one triangle is already larger than the current 360B
interval-BOOL charge it tries to delete. It also does not remove the edge
features without extra shifted-bound gathers/equality vectors. Minimum result:
>=1735, no build warranted.

**Packed per-axis code selector also loses.** A U8 code `[1,30]` can pack
outside/in/edge states, but the existing free-output node needs independent
rank-1 `in_span` and `on_edge` factors so the coefficient table can form
`row_in*col_edge + row_edge*col_in - row_edge*col_edge`. Feeding scalar row/col
codes directly cannot represent the required 3x3 state table with one bilinear
term. A 1-D embedding Gather from code to features is possible, but its output
is the same charged `[3,30]` separable feature tensor as v8 and the code still
needs the same span/edge generator (or the losing Trilu route above). Avoiding
that unpack requires a 2-D row-code/col-code product plus Gather/Equal tail,
which introduces a charged `[30,30]` plane (>=900B) and collapses into the dead
label-canvas family. The code stays cheap only while it is 1-D; exact color
selection makes it 2-D or rehydrates v8. Minimum result: >=1735, no build
warranted.

With Trilu and packed-code closed, the named irreducible remains the per-axis
two-boundary interval decomposition feeding the separable free-output Einsum:
12 BOOL `[1,30]` interval vectors (360B), 4 F16 interval casts (240B), and the
two `[3,30]` feature concats (360B). No strict-below candidate was found or
staged.

## Don't-do log

_Record ruled-out hypotheses here so future agents don't retry them._

- 2026-06-09 | When deriving max row/col via reversed 30-long marginal vectors,
  subtract `ArgMax(reversed)` from 29, not from the cropped active constant 12.
  The latter makes bounds negative and silently paints only background.
- 2026-06-09 | Do not build background as channel 0 over the whole 13x13 crop.
  Padding outside the original active HxW must remain all-zero, so use an
  active-grid mask and a non-channel sentinel label before the final Equal.
- 2026-06-09 | Do not retry BOOL `ArgMax` for bbox scans. ONNX shape inference
  rejects `ArgMax` over `tensor(bool)`; the UINT8 casts are required.
- 2026-06-09 | Do not retry INT8/INT16 `Einsum` as a sub-1600 route. ONNX checker
  accepts them, but ORT CPU has no kernel for `Einsum(12)` on INT8/INT16. INT32
  runs but costs more than F16 for the feature stacks.
- 2026-06-09 | The tempting input-source rewrite is blocked by `Einsum` type
  consistency: the official input is F32 while the cheap final factors are F16.
  Casting the full input to F16 would dominate the score.
- 2026-06-12 | ORT Cast(F32→UINT8) is MODULAR (not saturating). A direct
  Cast(row_combo→UINT8) for fg ArgMax fails: combo=1027 (4 fg cells × 255)
  becomes UINT8(1027 mod 256) = 3, which is LESS than the bg value (11).
  The Greater+Cast(BOOL→UINT8) fg chain is the minimum-cost ArgMax path.
- 2026-06-12 | Cast(BOOL→F16) for ArgMax produces F16 [1,30]=60B per axis
  vs UINT8 [1,30]=30B. Do not use F16 for the ArgMax intermediates.
- 2026-06-12 | Removing `batch_one_h` (1 param) requires Unsqueeze or Reshape
  after the final Einsum, creating an [10,30,30] F16 intermediate = 18000B.
  Not a net savings.
